passages.text: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and related notes thereto included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This discussion contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Factors that could cause or contribute to such differences include those identified below and those discussed in the section titled “Risk Factors” and other sections of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for any period in the future. In addition, this “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” section generally discusses 2025 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024. Discussions of 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 are not included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and can be found in “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the SEC on February 14, 2025. Overview DoorDash, Inc. is incorporated in Delaware with headquarters in San Francisco, California. Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We aim to do this by providing services that reduce friction in local commerce and help merchants better connect with consumers in their communities. 53 Table of Contents Our primary offerings include the DoorDash Marketplace, the Wolt Marketplace, and the Deliveroo Marketplace (together, our "Marketplaces"), and our Commerce Platform. Our Marketplaces operate in over 40 countries and provide an integrated suite of services that help merchants establish an online presence, connect with consumers in their communities, and solve mission-critical challenges, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. We also offer advertising as a value-added service through our Marketplaces to help merchants and consumer packaged goods companies increase consumer engagement and drive incremental revenue. Our Marketplaces seek to attract and retain consumers based primarily on the selection, convenience, quality, affordability, and service we provide. Our Marketplaces also offer our consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus, which aim to lower transactional friction by reducing the delivery and service fees we charge, while providing additional membership benefits. In addition to our Marketplaces, we offer our Commerce Platform, which is a suite of services that help empower merchants to build, operate, and grow their businesses on their own channels. Within our Commerce Platform, we offer white-label delivery fulfillment services ("Drive") as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: — Risks Related to Our Business and Operations— We have been subject to cybersecurity incidents in the past and anticipate being the target of future attacks. Any actual or perceived cybersecurity incident or security or privacy breach, particularly those involving our key systems, data, or critical third-party providers, could interrupt our operations, subject us to claims, litigation, regulatory investigations and liability, and adversely affect our reputation, brand, business, financial condition, and results of operations .” Governance Our board of directors is responsible for overseeing risk management for the Company and administers this responsibility both directly and with assistance from its committees. Our board of directors has designated our audit committee to administer oversight of cybersecurity risk management, which is a critical component of our enterprise risk management program. As such, our audit committee receives regular updates on our cybersecurity program and is actively involved in reviewing our cybersecurity and technology risks and opportunities, risk mitigation strategies, incident and industry trends, areas of emerging risks, and other areas of importance, including with respect to cybersecurity. Security updates are also provided to the full board of directors from time to time. The Company's cybersecurity risk management is led by our Vice President and Chief Information Security Officer (“CISO”) Suha Can, who reports to our General Counsel, and is responsible for assessing and managing information security and technology risks across our global operations. Our CISO has more than 20 years of experience in cybersecurity and engineering leadership roles at technology companies, and holds degrees in software engineering and business. He is supported by experienced regional and functional security leaders who are responsible for assisting him in assessing and managing information security, technology, and related risks for our global operations. Management is responsible for assessing, identifying, and managing material cybersecurity risks. Our CISO and his globally distributed teams meet regularly with each other and with members of management to review and evaluate our 49 Table of Contents cybersecurity risks and risk management program. As part of its oversight of cybersecurity risks, our audit committee receives regular updates from management on the risks and status of our security program. Additionally, our cybersecurity program has in place coordinated cybersecurity incident response processes that set forth procedures for managing and responding to cybersecurity incidents across the enterprise, including the assignment of cross-functional roles and responsibilities and protocols for the escalation of significant incidents to members of management and our audit committee. credit_strengths.text: DoorDash's revenue has compounded rapidly across the three-year trend, with the latest fiscal year materially above the prior period and well ahead of sector median growth. This scale supports marketplace economics, advertising attach and membership retention, giving the issuer a widening base over which fixed technology and support costs are absorbed.

Operating cash flow has risen each year and comfortably funds capital expenditure, leaving substantial free cash flow. Cash generation covers the convertible notes many times over, and the resulting net cash position means the balance sheet carries no net leverage, a profile stronger than the sector median.

key_risks.text: The issuer discloses past cybersecurity incidents and expects future attacks, warning that a breach of key systems, data or critical third-party providers could interrupt operations, trigger claims, litigation and regulatory liability, and damage reputation and financial condition. For a marketplace dependent on continuous order flow and payment data, such an event is a genuine operational and contingent liability risk.

Debt consists solely of convertible notes, with no aggregate debt line tagged and no short-term borrowings or commercial paper identified. The absence of a tagged maturity schedule and of interest expense data limits assessment of refinancing timing and cash interest burden, though conversion features may mitigate repayment risk if equity values hold.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Free cash flow relative to debt is high and operating cash flow dwarfs the convertible notes, so servicing capacity is not in question on current cash generation. The missing interest expense tag prevents a coverage calculation, but with net cash and no tagged short-term borrowings, cash interest burden appears modest relative to earnings.

Liquidity is adequate: current assets exceed current liabilities, and cash alone covers the convertible notes. The current ratio sits above the sector median, while the Altman Z double-prime score falls in the grey zone, reflecting the asset-light, high-growth profile rather than near-term repayment stress.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, driven by net cash and strong cash conversion. Gross leverage is below the sector median, operating margin is thin versus sector peers but improving sharply, and the Altman grey zone reflects growth-stage characteristics. Our judgement is that credit quality is solid, with the main uncertainty being the untagged debt maturity profile.

Acquisition spending absorbed most free cash flow in the period, and no buybacks or dividends were tagged, so shareholder returns are not currently a drain. If acquisition intensity persists, leverage could rise from a net cash base; we would monitor integration risk and any new debt issuance, but the starting point remains comfortable.

credit_strengths.text: DoorDash 的收入在三年趨勢中快速複合增長，最近一個財政年度顯著高於上一期間，並遠超行業中位數增長。此規模支持市場經濟、廣告附著率及會員留存，使發行人擁有不斷擴大的基礎來吸收固定技術及支持成本。
營運現金流逐年上升，並輕鬆為資本支出提供資金，留下大量自由現金流。現金產生覆蓋可轉換票據多倍，而由此產生的淨現金狀況意味著資產負債表不帶淨槓桿，此狀況強於行業中位數。

key_risks.text: 發行人披露過往網絡安全事件並預期未來攻擊，警告關鍵系統、數據或關鍵第三方供應商遭入侵可能中斷營運、引發索賠、訴訟及監管責任，並損害聲譽及財務狀況。對於依賴持續訂單流及支付數據的市場而言，此類事件是真正的營運及或然負債風險。
債務僅由可轉換票據組成，並無標籤的總債務項目，亦無識別短期借款或商業票據。缺乏標籤的到期時間表及利息費用數據限制了對再融資時間及現金利息負擔的評估，儘管若股權價值保持，轉換特徵可能減輕還款風險。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 自由現金流相對債務較高，營運現金流遠超可轉換票據，因此按當前現金產生，償債能力不成問題。缺失的利息費用標籤阻礙了覆蓋率計算，但由於淨現金及無標籤短期借款，現金利息負擔相對於盈利似乎適度。
流動性充足：流動資產超過流動負債，僅現金已覆蓋可轉換票據。流動比率高於行業中位數，而 Altman Z 雙素分數落在灰色區域，反映輕資產、高增長特徵而非近期還款壓力。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為極低，受淨現金及強勁現金轉換驅動。總槓桿低於行業中位數，營運利潤率相對於行業同儕偏薄但大幅改善，而 Altman 灰色區域反映增長階段特徵。我們的判斷是信用質量穩健，主要不確定性在於未標籤的債務到期狀況。
收購支出在期內吸收了大部分自由現金流，且無標籤回購或股息，因此股東回報目前並非消耗。若收購強度持續，槓桿可能從淨現金基礎上升；我們將監控整合風險及任何新債務發行，但起點仍然舒適。
